question: What is India’s rank in the Global Innovation Index, 2025, published by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**38th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India has achieved the **38th** rank in the **Global Innovation Index (GII) 2025**, marking a significant milestone in its journey toward becoming a global innovation hub. ***Hence, the correct option is 38th.***
 
• The index is published annually by the **World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO)**, a specialized agency of the **United Nations** headquartered in **Geneva, Switzerland**.
 
• This ranking represents a steady rise for India, which moved up from the **39th** position in **2024** and the **40th** position in **2023**. Over the last decade, India has climbed remarkably from its **81st** rank in **2015**.
 
• India continues to lead the **lower-middle-income economy group** and maintains its top position in the **Central and Southern Asia** region for innovation.
